reason: The agent booked the table without reading back the name, time, and party size and asking for confirmation first.
name: Missing booking confirmation

spec.goal: Book a table for tonight for three people under Khalid.
spec.behavior: You are polite and direct. Give your details when asked, and once the agent says the table is booked, respond briefly and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Before confirming a booking, read back the name, time and party size and ask the caller to confirm.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent repeats Khalid, six o'clock, and three guests, asks for confirmation, and only then confirms the booking after the caller says yes.
